baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا ... أَنْ أَنْذِرْ ... مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: A commissioned message is inserted before an approaching painful event so that fear can become caution while time remains.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message branch makes the dispatch a carried warning rather than bare movement.
Warning that awakens fear and caution supplies the intended change in the hearers before harm.
Priorness supplies the open temporal interval in which the warning can operate.
Coming and arrival make the threatened event an approaching occurrence rather than a static condition.
Torment and punishment identify the approaching event as imposed severe harm.
Causing pain makes the consequence experientially injurious, not merely adverse in status.

changed_reading.before: God sends Noah to announce a future punishment.
changed_reading.after: God dispatches a message as an intervention placed inside the remaining interval before an already approaching, pain-producing consequence.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same collective is marked first as Noah's relation and then as his charge; branches of guardianship and self-binding make warning a form of accountable care.

activation_trace.role: The people-group branch keeps both possessive phrases attached to one concrete collective.
Care, guardianship, and preservation recast Noah's relation to the group as protective responsibility.
Self-binding to a non-obligatory vow contributes an obligation image to the imperative to warn.
The envoy branch makes that responsibility an authorized commission toward his own people.

changed_reading.before: Noah relays a threat to an audience identified by kinship.
changed_reading.after: The commission places Noah under a protective obligation toward a collective that is simultaneously his own relation and his entrusted charge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal 'before' also opens a facing-position: advance warning can give the group capacity to meet or withstand what is coming.

activation_trace.role: Facing one thing toward another spatializes the encounter implicit in 'before.'
Capacity to face or withstand supplies the possible function of receiving advance warning.
Arrival supplies the event toward which the people are being oriented.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter make the warned collective potentially responsive rather than passive.

changed_reading.before: 'Before' only dates the warning earlier than punishment.
changed_reading.after: 'Before' marks a preparatory threshold at which the people may turn, rise, and become able to face the arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interval before harm becomes a conditional protection protocol: guarding and forgiveness can defer the people to an appointed limit, but that divine limit cannot itself be deferred once it arrives.

activation_trace.role: Caution-awakening warning anchors the response function of the temporal window.
Priorness supplies the bounded opportunity before consequence.
Arrival anchors the point at which that opportunity closes.
Ward-off-harm protection supplies the positive aim of responding to the warning.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer from its effect makes forgiveness operative protection.
Deferral to a later time distinguishes a granted delay from the final nondeferrable boundary.
A fixed temporal limit gives the warning window a hard horizon.
Coming and occurrence close the horizon once God's term is present.

structural_cues: 71:3-4 orders worship, guarding, and obedience before forgiveness and delay.
71:4 contrasts delay granted to the people with a divine term that is not delayed after arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, forgiveness, deferral, a fixed limit, and arrival; I infer that the focus's 'before' is a response window rather than mere chronology. A live alternative is that the delayed human term and the threatened punishment are related but not identical events.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is simply announced in advance.
changed_reading.after: The announcement opens a real protective interval whose response can cover prior wrong and defer the people, while preserving a nonnegotiable terminal boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The single commission unfolds as an iterative, mode-switching campaign across time and publicity, while the hearers counter-adapt through flight and deliberate control of auditory and visual access.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches lets one dispatch unfold as repeated communicative attempts.
The caution-awakening aim remains constant while delivery modes change.
Calling and inclining by speech turns the warning into repeated interpersonal address.
Night and its darkness extend the campaign into one temporal condition.
Day opening in light supplies the complementary temporal condition.
Flight makes failed reception an active movement away from the call.
Listening and accepting what is heard identify the channel the people deliberately disable.
A cover laid over something supplies the visual and bodily barrier paired with blocked hearing.
Open announcement and raised voice supply the public delivery mode.
Concealment in the interior supplies the private delivery mode.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 repeats the call across night/day and public/private pairs, with ثم marking renewed approaches.
The branchless fingers in 71:7 are retained only as a structural cue in the sequence ears, garments, persistence, and pride.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, complementary times and modes, flight, and sensory barriers; I infer a cycle of messenger adaptation and audience counter-adaptation. The live alternative is exhaustive persistence without deliberate strategy in the mode changes.

changed_reading.before: 'We sent Noah' suggests one proclamation whose content is the warning.
changed_reading.after: The sending authorizes a sustained adaptive campaign, and its failure is explained by active reception-control rather than by a lack of clarity or access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Noah's communicative dispatch is followed by a possible material dispatch from the sky: receptive response can turn the future arrival from painful consequence toward continuously released provision.

activation_trace.role: Sending forth and release anchors Noah's commission as the first dispatch.
Punishment and severe pain supply the negative arrival named in the focus.
Fresh sweet water supplies a latent positive pole that later rain can activate without replacing the punishment sense.
Seeking the covering of sin supplies the stated response before the beneficial dispatch.
The repeated sending-and-release branch explicitly pairs Noah's dispatch with the sky's dispatch.
Abundant outflow from a source gives the second dispatch its sustained material yield.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 sequences seeking forgiveness, sky-sending, wealth and children, gardens, and rivers.
The exact focus root ر س ل recurs at 71:11 with the sky rather than the messenger as the sent medium.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgiveness followed by sky-sending and abundant flow; I infer that the first dispatch offers access to a differently valenced second dispatch. A live alternative is that provision accompanies delay but does not replace the threatened punishment.

changed_reading.before: Noah is only the bearer of a threat about what will come.
changed_reading.after: Noah's sending is the first release in a conditional sequence that can culminate in another sending, this time an abundant life-supporting flow rather than painful arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people addressed in the focus are later described through successive formation, growth from earth, return into it, and extraction; this activates the rising branch of ق و م and places the warning at one phase-boundary in a larger itinerary.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and rising of the Hour turn the ordinary people-group into a collective that will stand again.
Priorness locates the warning before one transition within the larger sequence.
Successive phases and conditions supply the sequence's developmental frame.
Human growth and upbringing make the people products of a staged emergence from earth.
Return after departure supplies the movement back into earth after growth.
Bringing a hidden thing outward supplies the future re-emergence that activates rising.

structural_cues: The branchless كَيْفَ at 71:15 functions only as a structural invitation to inspect the creation mechanism.
71:17-18 forms an explicit emergence, return, then re-emergence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies phases, human growth, return, and extraction; I infer that these later movements reactivate the resurrection branch of the focus's repeated ق و م. The live alternative is that ق و م remains only an ordinary ethnos while the lifecycle sequence serves a separate proof of power.

changed_reading.before: The people are a present social group warned about one future disaster.
changed_reading.after: The people are also phase-bound beings grown, returned, and destined to rise, so the warning addresses their position in a longer itinerary than the immediate disaster.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated 'his people/your people' is no longer a flat ethnic audience: following and reproduction transmit misguidance, while believing entry into a household defines an alternative boundary of belonging and safety.

activation_trace.role: The people-group branch anchors every later differentiation in the focus's collective addressee.
Guardianship and preservation make the collective's internal organization consequential for whom the warning can protect.
Trailing and following supply a social transmission chain opposed to Noah's commission.
Lineal offspring project the collective's pattern into another generation.
Deviation from guidance identifies what the social and generational chain transmits.
Household and dependents supply a smaller alternative unit of belonging within the wider people.
Settled security and trust define the admission condition for that alternative community.

structural_cues: 71:21-24 moves from disobedience to following, elite increase, plotting, named cult objects, and mass misguidance.
71:26-28 shifts the classification from inhabitants and offspring to parents, house entrants, and believing men and women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, projected offspring, misguidance, household entry, and trust; I infer two competing reproduction systems for the focus's people, one inherited and one reconstituted by response. A live alternative is that the closing prayer's categories are forensic classifications rather than a social model.

changed_reading.before: 'Your people' is an undifferentiated kin group receiving the same warning.
changed_reading.after: 'Your people' is a contested transmission network whose loyalties and offspring reproduce refusal, while a believing household forms a different line of protected belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant 'open to the sky' image inside عذاب and links it to several later coverings. It remains anchored in the focus's punishment root and in packet-backed cover and sky branches; downstream prose should present it as an exposure/covering analogy, never as a lexical gloss that عذاب means exposure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ, especially the ع ذ ب branch 'open to the sky'

activation_trace.role: Being uncovered beneath the sky supplies the focus-side image of exposure.
Pain-causing consequence keeps the exposure tied to the actual painful modifier.
A cover that preserves supplies the protective covering offered through forgiveness.
A cover laid over something supplies the hearers' self-made barrier against warning.
Clothing and what covers the self materialize the rejected audience's chosen cover.
The sky and what overhangs supplies the exposed upper field from which another dispatch descends.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness, garments, and the threatened punishment are separate motifs.
changed_reading.after: The warning scene can carry a contest of coverings: forgiveness offers protective cover, the hearers cover themselves against that offer, and refusal leaves them exposed beneath the sky of consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This legal reading is branch-distant because the surface verb is ordinary warning, not a wound claim or guarantee. It remains anchored by the focus-only branches of compensable wound, surety, envoy, and pain; downstream prose should say the commission echoes an advance-notice liability structure, not that the verse states a technical legal rule.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا ... أَنْ أَنْذِرْ ... مِنْ قَبْلِ ... أَلِيمٌ

activation_trace.role: The envoy and carried message supply an authorized act of notice.
A wound carrying obligatory compensation supplies the remote liability image inside the warning root.
Standing surety for something supplies the guarantee-like function of notice before consequence.
Causing pain keeps the liability analogy attached to the threatened injury.

changed_reading.before: The messenger merely predicts a painful event.
changed_reading.after: The dispatch can also echo formal advance notice: an authorized envoy makes the coming injury forewarned and the hearers answerable to a clearly delivered caution.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy and must not be rendered as though عذاب lexically means floodwater. It remains validly anchored by the focus's incoming-torrent and sweet-water branches, the explicit punishment branch, and later packet-backed sky-flow and drowning; downstream prose should qualify it as a polarity in how arrival is pictured.

activation_trace.role: A torrent arriving from elsewhere gives the focus's coming event a latent hydraulic image.
Fresh sweet water supplies the life-giving pole of the water analogy.
Punishment and torment preserve the actual negative sense of the focus noun.
Sending forth makes the sky's water a released incoming medium.
Abundant outflow supplies the beneficial high-volume arrival.
Drowning in water supplies the destructive high-volume arrival.

changed_reading.before: The warning's punishment and the later rain are unrelated outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The coming consequence can be pictured through a hydraulic bifurcation: receptive response is followed by sky-sent abundance, while refusal ends in water that overwhelms rather than sustains.

strongest_changes: The focus's 'before' became a conditional protection window bounded by a nondeferrable term.
The single sending became an iterative multimodal campaign met by deliberate control of access.
The repeated ر س ل at 71:11 paired Noah's dispatch with a possible beneficial dispatch from the sky.
The doubled ق و م became both a phase-bound collective destined to rise and a contested intergenerational network.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were reversals inside shared material images: sending could carry message or rain, covering could protect or block reception, and incoming water could sustain or engulf, while every reading remained attached to the focus's dispatch, people, warning, priorness, arrival, punishment, or pain.
remaining_uncertainties: The delayed term in 71:4 may not be identical to the painful punishment named in 71:1.
The water and covering models may be deliberate material analogies or unusually coherent branch overactivation.
The resurrection branch of ق و م is contextually activated but remains form-distant from ordinary 'people.'
The legal notice outlier should remain an echo of branch structure, not a claimed technical meaning.
